title: H$_1$-ISS Analysis and Boundary Control Design for Coupled Linear ODEs and Hyperbolic PDEs
summary: This paper considers the general problem of the design of boundary controllers for distributed parameter systems. The control objectives are the asymptotic stability of the closed-loop system, as well as the disturbance attenuation of exogenous disturbances affecting the measurements and boundary conditions. More specifically, this work studies input-to-state stability (ISS) and stabilization for systems governed by coupled linear ordinary differential equations (ODEs) and homogeneous linear hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs), where actuation, sensing, and disturbance inputs…
